explanation: Lymphatics from the testis run back with the testicular artery to para-aortic nodes alongside the aorta at the level of origin of the testicular arteries (L2 vertebra), i.e., above the umbilicus. The testicular lymph there-fore does not drain to inguinal nodes, although the overlying scrotal skin does.
